Retirement review

Review removal requests and low-demand content before deciding what to retire.

What drives the score

Includes removal requests, demand candidates and low-demand items needing evidence.

Retirement bands: ≤250 or ≤500 annual views and an update older than 12 months.

Demand thresholds are provisional and configured separately for Workshops and Sprints. Compare their impact in Admin before changing policy.

Base: low demand 50%, update age 35%, missing contact 15%.

With usable QA: 75% base + 25% P2/P3 content-hygiene error score. P1 stays in urgent action.

Demand candidates need verified update and publication dates and attributable demand. Otherwise they stay in evidence review. Grace and keep-active exceptions apply. Admin approval does not confirm removal in WMS.

Unknown inputs are omitted and weights rebalance. Without usable completed QA, the base score stands. QA measures reported content hygiene; it does not establish relevance, obsolescence or complete quality. Open a row for evidence.
